api:
<Sankey data={flows} source={|f: &Flow| f.from} target={|f: &Flow| f.to} value={|f: &Flow| f.amount} />
PropTypeDefault
dataas above: one row per linkrequired
source, targetFn(&T) -> &str: node names; nodes are created from themrequired
valueFn(&T) -> f64required
node_widthf32, pixels12.
node_paddingf32: the vertical space between nodes, pixels12.
link_opacityf320.4
tooltipTooltipshown
classTailwind classes ("h-64")

Nodes are placed in columns by their distance from a source and sized by the larger of what flows in and out. Hover a node or a link to see its amount. Links must not form a loop.

examples.title: Energy flows
examples.description: Sources to uses; hover a node or a band for its amount.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn energy_flow() {
    let data = use_signal(energy());
    rsx! { <Sankey data={data} source={|f: &Flow| f.from} target={|f: &Flow| f.to} value={|f: &Flow| f.amount} class="h-96" /> }
}

examples.title: Household budget
examples.description: Income into one budget and out into categories.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn budget() {
    let data = use_signal(
        [
            ("Salary", "Budget", 4200.),
            ("Freelance", "Budget", 900.),
            ("Budget", "Rent", 1600.),
            ("Budget", "Food", 700.),
            ("Budget", "Savings", 1500.),
            ("Budget", "Transport", 300.),
            ("Budget", "Fun", 1000.),
        ]
        .map(|(from, to, amount)| Flow { from, to, amount })
        .to_vec(),
    );
    rsx! { <Sankey data={data} source={|f: &Flow| f.from} target={|f: &Flow| f.to} value={|f: &Flow| f.amount} node_width={18.} link_opacity={0.55} class="h-80" /> }
}
